content.query:
WITH Location_SK 
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(LocationSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimLocation
)

SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM Location_SK) AS LocationSK
,BL.LocationId AS LocationID
,BL.LocationCity AS City
,BS.StateName AS Province
,NULL AS Region
,NULL AS ZipCode --No mapping yet
,BC.IsoCountryName AS Country
,BL.SourceCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[LOCATION] BL
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[STATE] BS ON BL.LOCATIONSTATEID = BS.STATEID
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[COUNTRY] BC ON BL.COUNTRYID = BC.COUNTRYID
